reasons: CS2109S requires MA1511 and MA1512 (or MA1521/MA2002 etc) as prerequisites. These math modules are not listed in the 'must take' requirements, nor are they prerequisites for any other required course (CS2030S, CS2109S, CS3213, CS3230). Without planning these math courses, CS2109S cannot be taken. Adding them violates the rule against adding courses not needed as prerequisites for planned courses, or if added, they create a schedule that cannot satisfy the 'CS2109S and CS2030S in same semester' constraint while fitting all other constraints in the available semesters due to prerequisite chains and semester offerings.
